title: Compact-support candidate attached to a compactification
statement:
Let $K_0$ be a field, let $X,Y$ be finite-type
[def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties] $K_0$-schemes, and let $f:X\to Y$ be a
separated finite-type $K_0$-morphism. Fix a prime $\ell$, write
$\Ql=\mathbf Q_\ell$, and require that its image in $K_0$ is invertible.
Choose a finite extension $E/\Ql$, an integer $n\in\mathbf Z_{\geq1}$, and
put $A=A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension].
For a scheme $T$ write $D(T_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$ for the derived category of
sheaves of $A$-modules on the small pro-etale site of $T$
[def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Let $c=(j,\bar f)$ be an object of the
compactification category [def-weil-compactifications-refinements]
$\operatorname{Comp}(f)$: $j:X\hookrightarrow\overline X$ an open immersion
and $\bar f:\overline X\to Y$ proper with $\bar f\circ j=f$. The
extension-by-zero functor [def-weil-extension-by-zero]
$j_!:\Sh(X_{\mathrm{proet}},A)\to\Sh(\overline X_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$ is exact
[lem-weil-extension-by-zero-exact], so applying it termwise to complexes
induces a functor $j_!:D(X_{\mathrm{proet}},A)\to D(\overline X_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$
[lem-sf-exact-functor-derived-triangulated]. With the derived direct image
[def-weil-derived-direct-image]
$R\bar f_{*,n}:D(\overline X_{\mathrm{proet}},A)\to D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$,
computed by a K-injective resolution, set

$$
 Rf_{!,n}^{c}=R\bar f_{*,n}\,j_!:
 D(X_{\mathrm{proet}},A)
 \longrightarrow D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},A),
$$

the composite functor, attached to the chosen compactification $c$. The
definition asserts nothing beyond this formula. (Scope remark, not part of
the definition: every property asserted of $Rf_{!,n}^{c}$ elsewhere in the
blueprint, namely independence of the chosen compactification, base-change
compatibility, coherence and the finite-level comparisons, is asserted only
on the full subcategory $\mathcal D^{+}_{\mathrm{et}}(X,A)\subseteq
D(X_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$ of complexes coming from the etale site
[def-sf-etale-origin-subcategory]; there the superscript $c$ may be dropped.)

split_report.summary: Checked against the master blueprint node (order 1472; slopmaster2 blueprint has no file for it) and against the source repository's Lean AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactification (WeilConjectures/SixFunctors/ProEtale/Derived/LowerShriek.lean lines 86-100, same lines on master and slopmaster2, sorry-free), which is D(i_!) followed by R(g_*) for a compactification (Z, g proper, i open immersion, f = i >> g), with sheaves valued in any Grothendieck abelian category A (specializing to sheaves of A_{E,n}-modules). The definition is split into: coefficients A_{E,n} (def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension, replacing def-weil-finite-torsion-constructibility, which is stated only for the finite-field datum), the derived categories D(T_proet, A) (def-weil-pbc-proetale-site), Comp(f) (def-weil-compactifications-refinements), j_! (def-weil-extension-by-zero) with its exactness (lem-weil-extension-by-zero-exact) and the induced functor on derived categories (Mathlib leaf lem-sf-exact-functor-derived-triangulated, Functor.mapDerivedCategory), R\bar f_{*,n} (def-weil-derived-direct-image), and, for the scope remark only, the subcategory D^+_et (def-sf-etale-origin-subcategory, which carries the etale-origin witness, so def-weil-pbc-etale-origin-witness is no longer cited directly). The scope remark is rewritten as a remark: its claims that D^+_et contains the finite-torsion constructible complexes and that the functor is independent of c there are properties proved elsewhere (lem-sf-proetale-constructible-origin, prop-compactification-coherence-detailed, which depends on this node), not part of the definition, and were dropped from it. No new node was needed.

lean.note: §1(B), import-only repair: AmbientExceptionalRightAdjoint imports the intrinsic FiniteCoefficient framework, whose notation declarations collide with the upstream general framework required by the recorded RefinementComparisonIsomorphism. Use the existing upstream candidate, specialized to ModuleCat of ULift A_{E,n}. It is exactly termwise exact open extension by zero followed by K-injective derived proper direct image. These are the same fixed-scalar functors transported by the intrinsic candidate through its specified coefficient realization equivalences. The consumer uses the canonical inverse coefficient realization already supplied by def-sf-refinement-comparison-isomorphism; it retains the bounded-below etale-origin triple and all ambient morphisms. No new functor or ambient coherence assertion replaces the node.

[def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties] $K_0$-schemes, and let $f:X\to Y$ be a
separated finite-type $K_0$-morphism. Fix a prime $\ell$, write
$\Ql=\mathbf Q_\ell$, and require that its image in $K_0$ is invertible.
Choose a finite extension $E/\Ql$, an integer $n\in\mathbf Z_{\geq1}$, and
put $A=A_{E,n}$. Let $c=(j,\bar f)$ be an object of the compactification
category [def-weil-compactifications-refinements] $\operatorname{Comp}(f)$.
Using the finite-torsion coefficient sheaves
[def-weil-finite-torsion-constructibility] $A$, the derived direct image
[def-weil-derived-direct-image] $R\bar f_{*,n}$, and the extension-by-zero
functor [def-weil-extension-by-zero] $j_!$, set

$$
 Rf_{!,n}^{c}=R\bar f_{*,n}\,j_!:
 D(X_{\mathrm{proet}},A)
 \longrightarrow D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},A),

a functor attached to the chosen compactification $c$. Let $\mathcal

etale-origin witness of the proper-base-change chapter; it contains the

[def-weil-finite-torsion-constructibility] together with their witnesses. On
$\mathcal D^{+}_{\mathrm{et}}(X,A)$ the superscript $c$ may be dropped.
Here $R\bar f_{*,n}$ is computed by a K-injective resolution and $j_!$ is
exact.
